skill.name: CrewAI Observability Auto-Monitoring
skill.description: Enable automatic monitoring and observability for CrewAI agents by setting the AGENTOPS_API_KEY environment variable. Provides dashboard visibility of crew execution with minimal code changes.
skill.skill_body:
Set AGENTOPS_API_KEY in your environment before deploying CrewAI crews. Once configured, crews will automatically report to the AgentOps dashboard without requiring code modifications.

## Objective

enable_crew_observability
## Applicable Signals

- CrewAI framework in use
- AgentOps account and API key provisioned
- Observability dashboard access required

## Contraindications

- Using non-CrewAI agent frameworks
- AgentOps API key not available or not provisioned
- Observability not required or not permitted by deployment policy

## Workflow Steps

- {'step': 1, 'action': 'Obtain AgentOps API key from AgentOps account', 'note': 'Ensure key is valid and has appropriate permissions'}
- {'step': 2, 'action': 'Set AGENTOPS_API_KEY environment variable', 'note': 'Can be set via shell export, .env file, or deployment platform secrets'}
- {'step': 3, 'action': 'Deploy or run CrewAI crews', 'note': 'No code changes required; auto-instrumentation activates on environment variable detection'}
- {'step': 4, 'action': 'Verify crew execution appears on AgentOps dashboard', 'note': 'Check dashboard for crew runs, task execution, and agent interactions'}

## Constraints

- AGENTOPS_API_KEY must be set in environment before crew initialization
- AgentOps account and valid API key required
- CrewAI framework must be installed and configured

## Cautions

- Ensure API key is kept secure and not committed to version control
- Dashboard visibility may have latency; allow time for data propagation
- Verify network connectivity to AgentOps service from deployment environment

## Output Contract

- AGENTOPS_API_KEY successfully set in environment; CrewAI crews automatically monitored and visible on AgentOps dashboard with execution traces, task logs, and agent interactions recorded.
